summary.headline: Theophilus and Dorotheus on Astrology
summary.text: Zodiacal omen interpretations continue with Virgo through Pisces, followed by a scholion of Theophilus on determining life through predominators, malefic rays, benefics, and ascensional times. A passage of Dorotheus on planetary ingresses describes the effects of Saturn, Jupiter, Venus, Mars, the Sun, Mercury, and Moon in conjunctions, squares, and oppositions.
